name: customer_late_payment_reminders
description: Finds customer invoices unpaid past due date, computes days late and amounts, and drafts a short polite reminder for each customer.

manifest.name: customer_late_payment_reminders
manifest.description: Finds customer invoices unpaid past due date, computes days late and amounts, and drafts a short polite reminder for each customer.
manifest.purpose:
a bot that lists which customers are late paying us, how many days late and how much, with a short polite reminder for each

Files: folder novak_trading
manifest.headline: {items.length} overdue invoices totaling {total_amount} CZK across {unique_customers} customers
examples: Show me all customers who are late paying
Which invoices are more than 5 days overdue?
Generate payment reminders for Moravia Consult
manifest.manual_basis: Extracting overdue invoices from accounting records, calculating days late, summing amounts, and composing personalized reminder letters.
